audience: a parent or patient-group leader without medical training

sentences.text: GM1 gangliosidosis type 3 is linked to the gene GLB1 in curated databases [e_36b166c2cc71].
Mucopolysaccharidosis type 4 is linked to GLB1 only by inference from subtype 4B, with confidence 0.475, and this may not hold for every form [e_52e373066985].
It is also linked to a second gene, GALNS, again only by inference from subtype 4A [e_c239feee0cf8].
GLB1 and GALNS both take part in the same curated pathway, keratan sulfate degradation [e_10f453590dd2] [e_9addb76c341d].
Constellate computed that the two diseases share the gene GLB1, with confidence 0.475, which is inferred [e_4582a554359d].

For type 3, reduced beta-galactosidase activity is an observed feature, while coarse facial features and seizures are marked as contradicted, with 1 contradicting record each [e_59cddd3cf090] [e_6ba1c1cbb7ee] [e_13d9d4bb1de7].
For mucopolysaccharidosis type 4, one study is listed as recruiting and one newborn screening study as completed [e_1fcff86aef59] [e_7f28d7b0cdcb].
These edges do not show any study for GM1 gangliosidosis type 3 [e_36b166c2cc71].
